name: Naija & Africa
description: Nigerian history, geography, music and film, plus the wider continent.

questions.question: On what date did Nigeria gain independence from Britain?
questions.note: Nigeria became a republic three years later, on 1 October 1963.

questions.question: Which city became Nigeria's capital in 1991?
questions.note: The capital moved from Lagos to Abuja on 12 December 1991.

questions.question: How many states does Nigeria have?
questions.note: 36 states plus the Federal Capital Territory.

questions.question: Who was Nigeria's first president?
questions.note: Azikiwe became ceremonial president when Nigeria became a republic in 1963; Balewa was the first prime minister.

questions.question: Wole Soyinka won the Nobel Prize in Literature in which year?
questions.note: The first African writer to win the prize.

questions.note: Twice as Tall won Best Global Music Album.

questions.question: What is Nigeria's film industry commonly called?
questions.note: Kannywood is the Hausa-language industry based in Kano.

questions.question: How many times have the Super Eagles won the Africa Cup of Nations?
Nigeria won Olympic gold in men's football at which games?
questions.note: The Dream Team beat Argentina in the 1996 final.

questions.note: Moved from 29 May to 12 June in 2018, marking the annulled 1993 election.

questions.question: Queen Amina was a warrior queen of which historic city-state?
The famous Benin Bronzes were made by artists of which kingdom?
questions.note: The Kingdom of Benin, in present-day Edo State — not the neighbouring Republic of Benin.

questions.question: The Osun-Osogbo Sacred Grove festival honours which deity?
questions.note: The grove is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
